These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que he tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo descubre que Randall es un violador y asesino y acuerdan ejecutarlo, pero Dale se opone porque eso los convertiría también en criminales. Mientras tanto, Carl comete un error que acarreará consecuencias imprevistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las diferencias entre Rick y Shane por el liderato del grupo y la gestión de la granja se intensifican cuando Shane decide por su cuenta el destino de Randall. La tensión termina estallando y los dos amigos se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: Junto al fuego que se extingue
programme.desc: Una horda de zombis invade la granja y el grupo intenta escapar vivo entre el caos, pero no todos lo lograrán. Además, Rick se harta de las quejas del grupo y les da un ultimátum: si quieren que sea el líder, acatarán sus órdenes.

programme.sub-title: Cities Reinvented E02 - Tokyo - The Urban Village Concept
programme.desc: The Greater Tokyo Area is the world’s most populous metropolitan region, and it is continuing to grow at a fast pace. Urban-planning solutions are urgently needed to prevent Tokyo from choking on its own growth. Strategies include raising density, promoting shared housing and micro-homes, and investing in ‘urban villages’, neighborhoods where people can live, work and spend their leisure time.

programme.title: DW Cities Reinvented
programme.sub-title: Cities Reinvented E03 - Singapore - Embracing Nature
programme.desc: Singapore is arguably the world’s most modern metropolis. The small island state with a growing population needs to plan land use and construction carefully. It has become a pioneer in eco-friendly energy-saving urban development. The regulations are stringent: any green space lost when a new building goes up must be replaced somewhere else. The city is creating a new generation of green skyscrapers that harvest rainwater and run on solar power.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Samantha explores the history of the Abbey of the Genesee and the popular Monks’ Bread made by the Trappist monks. Samantha visits Chef Melanie Alvarez Santiago, to sample authentic Puerto Rican dishes. Samantha explores the "Grand Canyon of the East" and takes in the sights of Letchworth State Park then joins a community paint day and crafts a bucket at the Genesee Country Village & Museum.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Samantha kicks off her visit to the Garden State in Cape May, and discovers how it played a pivotal role in the fight to end slavery. Samantha visits Beach Plum Farm and talks with a conservationist at the Wetlands Institute about the ground-breaking research they are doing. Other stops include Monmouth Battlefield State Park, Source Farmhouse Brewery and legendary music venue, The Stone Pony.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: The Mission Reach project in San Antonio provides walking trails and bike paths and will use portals to connect the San Antonio River to the four historic missions along the river. Samantha tours several of its stops including a visit to Mission Concepcion and learns the history of the river and the impact of this urban ecosystem restoration project.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Samantha joins third-generation deli-man, Ziggy Gruber, in the kitchen to make matzoh ball soup then discusses Ziggy's storied family/deli history, and why his Houston-based Kenny and Ziggy's New York Delicatessen is tops in the nation. Freedmen's Town was originally a community located in the fourth ward of Houston that began in 1865 as the destination for former enslaved people from surrounding plantations in Texas and Louisiana after the Civil War.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Kentucky is synonymous with Bourbon. At Buffalo Trace Distillery, Samantha talks all things bourbon with third-generation employee Freddie Johnson, including the history of bourbon and how it got named. Visiting the Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest, Samantha learns how German immigrant Isaac W. Bernheim in 1929 used his fortune from bourbon to buy this land and give it back to the people of Kentucky, and how art has always been an important mission of the Forest.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Explore "Olympic City US" at the interactive US Olympic & Paralympic Museum. At the Colorado Wolf and Wildlife Center, Samantha discusses the centers’ mission of providing a home to wolves and foxes. Samantha explores Garden of the Gods and then hangs with the first Latina Brewery Owner in Colorado. Samantha visits Manitou Springs and a shop that repurposes old skis and snowboards into furniture.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Luego de seis meses, Simón es liberado de la cárcel. Jura vengarse de Iris por todo lo que le hizo y le pide que nunca más vuelva a verlo ni a él ni a su hijo. Neta quiere que Julie y Sofía conozcan su barrio, las personas que viven y cómo es la manera de vivir allí. Entre las tres, convencen a Rosario para que las lleve. Christian visita a Vicenta, y mientras están charlando, ella comienza a tener contracciones. Él decide no llamar ni a Federico ni a la ambulancia y llevarla él mismo a la clínica. Christian, a pesar de que Federico no está de acuerdo, presencia el parto y ayuda a Vicenta en ese momento difícil.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 34: Socorro hallada, Barbara esconde a Tommy.
programme.desc: Socorro sigue inconsciente en su camerino, y Ariel y Ulises aprovechan para sacarla del hotel donde se hizo el desfile. Al ver la demora de Socorro, Salvador va al camerino y al no encontrarla, empieza a buscarla por todo el hotel. Va al parqueadero y la encuentra dentro de la cajuela de un carro desmayada. La saca del lugar y un doctor la atiende. En el apartamento de Isabel, Bárbara se despierta y ve que Tommy duerme junto a ella. Bárbara se preocupa por lo que pudo haber pasado la noche anterior, pero él le asegura que no sucedió nada. María, preocupada por su hija, va a buscarla. Al escuchar su voz, Bárbara esconde a Tommy.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 34: Jesus golpea a Gabriel y Marisela
programme.desc: Jesús cuando oye a Gabriel gritando su nombre en la puerta, sale como enloquecido y comienza a golpearlo tratando de hacerlo marcharse, pero éste sigue allí impertérrito diciéndole lo mismo, que es necesario que se marchen a la clínica porque él está muy enfermo. Marisela trata de apaciguar la situación e intercede ante Jesús para que no siga golpeando a Gabriel y Jesús arremete en contra de ella, hasta que llegan los empleados del hotel que se hacen cargo de la situación e intentan tranquilizar tanto a Jesús como al resto de los huéspedes que están molestos con el escándalo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 77: Boda, despecho y nuevos amores
programme.desc: Rómulo se lo piensa bien, compara, para Eglee es solo un estorbo, un mueble viejo, para Betzaida el amor, la ternura, la palabra halagadora todo el tiempo; la pobre Betzaida esta asustada, le ruega que no le vaya hacer eso delante de su familia, el la observa y pues se decide, y acepta, se forma una algarabía, la familia de Betzaida grita, todas incluida ella misma, no se lo pueden creer, hasta el papá esta dichoso, no tanto así Eglee que hasta el último momento llego a pensar que Rómulo no se casaba y que sería ella la que saldría con el. Luis Fernando entiende a su mamá, quien después de todo se retira derrotada con su mejor amigo y su mejor hombro Marco Aurelio, éste que sabe bien por lo que esta pasando Eglee, la invita a comer en el mejor sitio de la ciudad, mas ella no acepta, necesita matar ese dolor, ese despecho, de ya no ser la mujer Rómulo, quien la ve ella que lo había botado por aburrido, por que según ella no servía para nada, que no le sacaba ni un mal pensamiento, ahora esta hecha un mar de llanto por hacerse casado con otra que si lo quiere y lo valora. Y es que esa es la rabia, verlo feliz con otra, y ella sola, mas sola que nunca, pues sola no es nada feliz. Dileidi conversa con su amiga Yenilu en su sitio de trabajo, le duele lo que pueda estar sintiendo la señora Eglee en ese momento, no quisiera estar en sus zapatos, su amiga sabe que lo que Dileidi teme es que Luis Fernando se vaya a enseriar con otra que no sea ella y se case. Theo esta con Gabriel contándole con lujo de detalles su salida con la Nena la noche anterior, y como Gabriel lo conoce le adivina todas las metidas de pata que hizo esa noche, luego le confiesa a sus amigos que lo peor no fue eso si no que la Nena le dijo que por un ratico estaría bien pero que de por vida no, Gabriel de alguna manera entiende a su amigo a el le pasa lo mismo, tantos años detrás de Gladis y nada la mujer no le para pero lo que se dice nada de nada, aconseja a Theo a que haga las cosas bien, que se deje de estar inventado si quiere conquistar de verdad a la Nena, que empiece por buscarse un buen empleo, a ver como le va de esa manera. Otra que esta echando el cuento es la Nena pero a su amiga Rosa, le cuenta que estuvo montada en una camioneta de pasajeros, rodeada de gente pobre y mal oliente, que comió perro caliente y que de paso se puso a ver tiendas sin tener medio en la cartera, pero al mismo tiempo reconoce que Theo tiene ese algo especial que la enamora, la conquista con solo verla, la hace reír con sus ocurrencias, le gusta la manera tan divertida que tiene Theo de ver las cosas, Rosa entiende que su amiga esta cada vez mas enamorada de ese hombre, que según Rosa es un encanto, un verdadero caballero. Matilde no esta de acuerdo con ir a la boda, pues su amiga y cuñada es Eglee, le parece que no es lo mas correcto, Gonzalo para varias piensa lo contrario, total si es verdad Eglee es su hermana, pero fue ella quien boto a Rómulo además Rómulo es su amigo y le darán una sorpresa, Gladis que escucha atenta la discusión le agradece a la vida que todos los hombres que pasaron por su vida la hayan botado, pues ella esta convencida que lo que le hicieron fue un favor al dejarla sola. Cuando sale de la casa de Matilde se acerca a una camioneta y aprovecha para arreglarse todo, se pinta la boca, se acomoda el pelo, se arregla hasta el sostén y cual es su sorpresa, el vidrio se baja y aparece nada mas ni nada menos que Marco Aurelio, quien estaba disfrutando viéndola desde adentro, ella se ruboriza toda, no se imagino que era el, Marco Aurelio le ofrece llevarla a su casa y ella acepta. Ya en la boda Nely se encarga de los detalles, Betzaida sabe que eso es lo a su mamá le gusta hacer, llegan Ramón y Pascuita y mas atrás Matilde y Gonzalo y cuando las dos parejas se saludan empieza el bombardeo de las dos mujeres, a Pascuita le molesta que Ramón alabe a Matilde y por ahí empieza la cosa. Otra que se aparece en la boda es la Nena en compañía de Theo y de su hija, quien esta feliz pues piensa que verá a Luis Fernando, cuando llega Theo se comporta de una manera tan fuera de lugar que ella siente mucha vergüenza, asume que con ese hombre solo se puede pasar pena, nada mas. Luis Fernando decide invitar a la miss a la boda de su papá, pero esta antes de salir cree que lo mas correcto es hablar con su amiga, la llama y le dice que se beso la noche anterior con Luis Fernando, a la pobre Dileidi casi le da un infarto, luego le dice que no importa que haga lo que ella quiera, total ya ese no es su novio, pero la procesión va por dentro. La que agarra una rasca es Eglee, que canta y todo para pasar mejor el despecho, llega Santiago quien no fue invitado a la boda, se le pone a la orden a Eglee y esta le dice que bailen que ella cantará, el acepta y una vez que están mas cerca Santiago no lo puede creer tiene en sus brazos a la mujer que le quita el sueño, esta lleno de gozo. Esta Aureliano en la platabanda pensando y haciendo un inventario de su vida sentimental antes de llegar a Caracas y después, en Yaritagua era un rey, no había mujer que se le resistiera en cambio en Caracas, Dileidi ha hecho con el lo que ninguna, en ese momento se aparece ella dolida pero disimula, el le dice que se busque su platabanda para matar el despecho que el llego primero, pero sorpresa, ella le dice que no esta ahí para llorar por nadie que esta ahí es por el.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 22: Luis Guillermo quiere irse y necesita dinero
programme.desc: Inés, muy preocupada, baja las escaleras de la mansión de los Nuñez preguntando a la Ama de Llaves Asunta, que quién había entrado en su habitación. En ese momento entra Luis Guillermo indicándole a Inés que deseaba hablar con ella. El tema de conversación era que él deseaba irse de la casa ya que en los últimos días esa casa tenía demasiados problemas y él creía que uno de los principales problemas era él. Que deseaba trabajar y apartarse de todo. Inés le indica que para eso no necesita mudarse de la casa, ya que siendo él el hermano mayor de los Nuñez, le correspondía vivir en la mansión. Luis Guillermo le dice a Inés que no se queda y que necesita dinero para mudarse. En otro escenario están Daniela y Debora.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

Neta quiere que Julie y Sofía conozcan su barrio, las personas que viven y cómo es la manera de vivir allí. Entre las tres, convencen a Rosario para que las lleve. Christian visita a Vicenta, y mientras están charlando, ella comienza a tener contracciones. Él decide no llamar ni a Federico ni a la ambulancia y llevarla él mismo a la clínica. Christian, a pesar de que Federico no está de acuerdo, presencia el parto y ayuda a Vicenta en ese momento difícil.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 34: Socorro hallada, Barbara esconde a Tommy.
programme.desc: Socorro sigue inconsciente en su camerino, y Ariel y Ulises aprovechan para sacarla del hotel donde se hizo el desfile. Al ver la demora de Socorro, Salvador va al camerino y al no encontrarla, empieza a buscarla por todo el hotel. Va al parqueadero y la encuentra dentro de la cajuela de un carro desmayada. La saca del lugar y un doctor la atiende. En el apartamento de Isabel, Bárbara se despierta y ve que Tommy duerme junto a ella. Bárbara se preocupa por lo que pudo haber pasado la noche anterior, pero él le asegura que no sucedió nada. María, preocupada por su hija, va a buscarla. Al escuchar su voz, Bárbara esconde a Tommy.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 34: Jesus golpea a Gabriel y Marisela
programme.desc: Jesús cuando oye a Gabriel gritando su nombre en la puerta, sale como enloquecido y comienza a golpearlo tratando de hacerlo marcharse, pero éste sigue allí impertérrito diciéndole lo mismo, que es necesario que se marchen a la clínica porque él está muy enfermo. Marisela trata de apaciguar la situación e intercede ante Jesús para que no siga golpeando a Gabriel y Jesús arremete en contra de ella, hasta que llegan los empleados del hotel que se hacen cargo de la situación e intentan tranquilizar tanto a Jesús como al resto de los huéspedes que están molestos con el escándalo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 77: Boda, despecho y nuevos amores
programme.desc: Rómulo se lo piensa bien, compara, para Eglee es solo un estorbo, un mueble viejo, para Betzaida el amor, la ternura, la palabra halagadora todo el tiempo; la pobre Betzaida esta asustada, le ruega que no le vaya hacer eso delante de su familia, el la observa y pues se decide, y acepta, se forma una algarabía, la familia de Betzaida grita, todas incluida ella misma, no se lo pueden creer, hasta el papá esta dichoso, no tanto así Eglee que hasta el último momento llego a pensar que Rómulo no se casaba y que sería ella la que saldría con el. Luis Fernando entiende a su mamá, quien después de todo se retira derrotada con su mejor amigo y su mejor hombro Marco Aurelio, éste que sabe bien por lo que esta pasando Eglee, la invita a comer en el mejor sitio de la ciudad, mas ella no acepta, necesita matar ese dolor, ese despecho, de ya no ser la mujer Rómulo, quien la ve ella que lo había botado por aburrido, por que según ella no servía para nada, que no le sacaba ni un mal pensamiento, ahora esta hecha un mar de llanto por hacerse casado con otra que si lo quiere y lo valora. Y es que esa es la rabia, verlo feliz con otra, y ella sola, mas sola que nunca, pues sola no es nada feliz. Dileidi conversa con su amiga Yenilu en su sitio de trabajo, le duele lo que pueda estar sintiendo la señora Eglee en ese momento, no quisiera estar en sus zapatos, su amiga sabe que lo que Dileidi teme es que Luis Fernando se vaya a enseriar con otra que no sea ella y se case. Theo esta con Gabriel contándole con lujo de detalles su salida con la Nena la noche anterior, y como Gabriel lo conoce le adivina todas las metidas de pata que hizo esa noche, luego le confiesa a sus amigos que lo peor no fue eso si no que la Nena le dijo que por un ratico estaría bien pero que de por vida no, Gabriel de alguna manera entiende a su amigo a el le pasa lo mismo, tantos años detrás de Gladis y nada la mujer no le para pero lo que se dice nada de nada, aconseja a Theo a que haga las cosas bien, que se deje de estar inventado si quiere conquistar de verdad a la Nena, que empiece por buscarse un buen empleo, a ver como le va de esa manera. Otra que esta echando el cuento es la Nena pero a su amiga Rosa, le cuenta que estuvo montada en una camioneta de pasajeros, rodeada de gente pobre y mal oliente, que comió perro caliente y que de paso se puso a ver tiendas sin tener medio en la cartera, pero al mismo tiempo reconoce que Theo tiene ese algo especial que la enamora, la conquista con solo verla, la hace reír con sus ocurrencias, le gusta la manera tan divertida que tiene Theo de ver las cosas, Rosa entiende que su amiga esta cada vez mas enamorada de ese hombre, que según Rosa es un encanto, un verdadero caballero. Matilde no esta de acuerdo con ir a la boda, pues su amiga y cuñada es Eglee, le parece que no es lo mas correcto, Gonzalo para varias piensa lo contrario, total si es verdad Eglee es su hermana, pero fue ella quien boto a Rómulo además Rómulo es su amigo y le darán una sorpresa, Gladis que escucha atenta la discusión le agradece a la vida que todos los hombres que pasaron por su vida la hayan botado, pues ella esta convencida que lo que le hicieron fue un favor al dejarla sola. Cuando sale de la casa de Matilde se acerca a una camioneta y aprovecha para arreglarse todo, se pinta la boca, se acomoda el pelo, se arregla hasta el sostén y cual es su sorpresa, el vidrio se baja y aparece nada mas ni nada menos que Marco Aurelio, quien estaba disfrutando viéndola desde adentro, ella se ruboriza toda, no se imagino que era el, Marco Aurelio le ofrece llevarla a su casa y ella acepta. Ya en la boda Nely se encarga de los detalles, Betzaida sabe que eso es lo a su mamá le gusta hacer, llegan Ramón y Pascuita y mas atrás Matilde y Gonzalo y cuando las dos parejas se saludan empieza el bombardeo de las dos mujeres, a Pascuita le molesta que Ramón alabe a Matilde y por ahí empieza la cosa. Otra que se aparece en la boda es la Nena en compañía de Theo y de su hija, quien esta feliz pues piensa que verá a Luis Fernando, cuando llega Theo se comporta de una manera tan fuera de lugar que ella siente mucha vergüenza, asume que con ese hombre solo se puede pasar pena, nada mas. Luis Fernando decide invitar a la miss a la boda de su papá, pero esta antes de salir cree que lo mas correcto es hablar con su amiga, la llama y le dice que se beso la noche anterior con Luis Fernando, a la pobre Dileidi casi le da un infarto, luego le dice que no importa que haga lo que ella quiera, total ya ese no es su novio, pero la procesión va por dentro. La que agarra una rasca es Eglee, que canta y todo para pasar mejor el despecho, llega Santiago quien no fue invitado a la boda, se le pone a la orden a Eglee y esta le dice que bailen que ella cantará, el acepta y una vez que están mas cerca Santiago no lo puede creer tiene en sus brazos a la mujer que le quita el sueño, esta lleno de gozo. Esta Aureliano en la platabanda pensando y haciendo un inventario de su vida sentimental antes de llegar a Caracas y después, en Yaritagua era un rey, no había mujer que se le resistiera en cambio en Caracas, Dileidi ha hecho con el lo que ninguna, en ese momento se aparece ella dolida pero disimula, el le dice que se busque su platabanda para matar el despecho que el llego primero, pero sorpresa, ella le dice que no esta ahí para llorar por nadie que esta ahí es por el.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 22: Luis Guillermo quiere irse y necesita dinero
programme.desc: Inés, muy preocupada, baja las escaleras de la mansión de los Nuñez preguntando a la Ama de Llaves Asunta, que quién había entrado en su habitación. En ese momento entra Luis Guillermo indicándole a Inés que deseaba hablar con ella. El tema de conversación era que él deseaba irse de la casa ya que en los últimos días esa casa tenía demasiados problemas y él creía que uno de los principales problemas era él. Que deseaba trabajar y apartarse de todo. Inés le indica que para eso no necesita mudarse de la casa, ya que siendo él el hermano mayor de los Nuñez, le correspondía vivir en la mansión. Luis Guillermo le dice a Inés que no se queda y que necesita dinero para mudarse. En otro escenario están Daniela y Debora.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta dan a luz en el mismo lugar y al mismo tiempo. La enfermera confunde los bebés, entregando a cada madre el hijo de la otra. Ellas, mediante su instinto, se dan cuenta de esto y deciden, por su cuenta, visitarse una a la otra para intentar solucionar este problema. Una jueza le da la custodia de Neta a Helda, justificándose en que es la única figura materna que tiene presente. Sin embargo, en un acto de injusticia, le permite a la chica vivir junto a su abuela en la mansión Humboldt, y le sugiere a Inmaculada que se mude, ya que ella es la que sobra. La viuda negra amenaza a Vanesa y quiere que mate a Ivana. Si ella no lo hace, su hija Julie está en peligro, razón por la cual Vanesa está muy nerviosa y perturbada.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and relaxes to some local jazz.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Puebla, Where the Good Cooks Are From
programme.desc: Puebla, Mexico: According to Tony, the best line cooks in NYC come from Mexico, so he travels to the Puebla, and enjoys mole sauces, toasted ant eggs, fried worms, and the legendary pulque (a slightly hallucinogenic drink made from cactus sap).

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Mekong River, Vietnam: On the river, Tony drinks a lot of Mekong moonshine with the welcoming owners of a duck farm. Although seduced by his Vietnam experience, Tony is not sure the royal dish Birds Nest Soup is all its cracked up to be.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better with Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, discovers foodstuffs not available at American supermarkets, and finally relaxes at a beach bar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Cobra Heart-Food That Makes You Manly
programme.desc: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France: Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland: Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Sahara): Tony traverses the Moroccan desert with one goal in mind, to eat a mud-oven-roasted sheep.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking
programme.desc: Melbourne, Australia boasts hard-living, good-natured, and eccentric lovers of food - Tony's kind of people. In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: The Struggle for the Soul of America
programme.desc: Tony travels to the grain-belt capital of Minneapolis, Minnesota to experience firsthand the conflict between creative independent operators and generic franchises.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England: In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes, and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: So Much Vodka, So Little Time
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia: Tony continues his mission with a tour of local working-class specialties. He tries his hand at ice-fishing, drinks a lot of vodka, feasts on Russian foods, eats smoked fish and ends the outing with a dip in the outdoor cold pool.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef and Owner Ryan Clift prepares more of the Tippling Club's signature dishes and drinks. Phil is then treated to the restaurant's extensive degustation menu that typifies Tippling's ever-evolving dining experience.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Where there is fire, there is grilling. Chef Benjamin Halat welcomes Phillip to Mandarin Grill at the Mandarin Oriental in Kuala Lumpur where he showcases the restaurant's stunning dishes and walks through how he carefully prepares them.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Gilles Marx prepares a few more of AMUZ Gourmet Restaurant's exceptionally flavorful dishes and shares how he became inspired to live and cook in beautiful Jakarta. Also, explore AMUZ's curated wine cellar.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: You Don't Know the Whole Enchilada
programme.desc: When you say the word "enchiladas," chances are you are thinking about the saucy, cheesy affairs we all know and love. In Mexico City, you will find a variety of enchiladas, both in the simplest of markets and in the nicest of restaurants.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Cooking in underground pits is an elemental part of Yucatecan cooking, and is downright sacred. In Yaxunah, Rick witnesses the process of making cochinita pibil. He also visits the smoky ovens in Temozon, stoking Rick's inner pit master.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.sub-title: Papua New Guinea: The Fire Dance
programme.desc: When a person dies, or to celebrate a harvest or important visit, the Baining tribesmen create masks representing the Spirit of the Forest. A great fire is then lit in the village, and dancers adorning the masks dance around the fire, jumping on the embers to prove they are stronger than the flames.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.desc: Anthropologist Anne-Sylvie Malbrancke journeys to meet Jenny, a young Peruvian who has crossed the country to ask the sacred lakes to heal her medical issue. For more than 700 years, shamans have drawn their power to heal from the Huaringas, sacred lagoons located on the border of Peru and Ecuador.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.sub-title: Saintes Maries de la Mer: Traveler Pride
programme.desc: On May 24 each year, travelers from Europe flock to Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer in France for a festive ritual in honor of Patron Saint Sara with whom travelers greatly identify. For one week, between 8,000 and 10,000 travelers travel to Camargue, filling the streets, squares, and seafront with energy.

programme.title: Inside America's National Parks
programme.desc: Experience the supreme and sacred spectacle of the Grand Canyon. programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: Known as the "land of good people," Mozambique offers some of the most wonderful outdoor experiences possible in Southern Africa, including the ability to explore the country's incredibly rich underwater marine parks.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: Madagascar split off from Africa some 150 million years ago. The isolation of being separated from the mainland caused the island's wildlife to develop distinct and unique features. programme.desc: Eric Landry es un hombre de corazón frío al que la gente ha apodado "la Bestia". Años de ira y amargura lo han consumido, convirtiéndolo en un hombre egoísta. Pero Belle Watson es exactamente lo contrario. Ella es cariñosa y amable. Trabaja duro para ayudar a su familia, a menudo sacrificando sus propias necesidades y deseos para satisfacer las necesidades de los demás. Cuando su padre rompe accidentalmente una valiosa obra de arte en la mansión Landry, Bella se ve inmersa en la vida de la Bestia. Haciendo todo lo posible por no dejarse intimidar por su mezquindad, Belles acepta trabajar para Eric en un esfuerzo por pagarle y salvar el trabajo de su padre. Ella descubre que podría haber más en Eric. ¿Encontrará al hombre dentro de la Bestia?

programme.title: Entrenando A Tu Esposo
programme.desc: Jillian es una exitosa terapeuta matrimonial y autora de libros de autoayuda sobre el matrimonio. Como su relación no va muy bien, intenta arreglar su propio matrimonio enfocándose en cómo cambiar a su esposo.

programme.title: Una Pizca De Amor
programme.desc: April viaja a Italia para salvar el contrato de su libro de cocina cuando sus recetas saludables son poco sabrosas. Por el camino descubre una nueva alegría y libertad en la vida y en la cocina, y también el amor.

programme.title: Amor en Whitbrooke
programme.desc: A una ambiciosa gestora de proyectos le ofrecen la oportunidad profesional de su vida en Londres. Pero cuando regresa a su ciudad natal para ayudar al negocio familiar en una emergencia y conoce al chico perfecto, su pasión y talento por la pintura se reavivan, dándole una nueva perspectiva de la vida y el amor.

programme.title: Retrato De Amor
programme.desc: Una conservadora de museo encuentra un cuadro idéntico a ella y busca a su pintor en Irlanda. Allí un hombre encantador la ayuda en su búsqueda y también a enamorarse de nuevo.

programme.title: Amor en El Arrecife
programme.desc: Un biólogo marino inteligente y serio y un instructor de buceo amante de la diversión y el laissez-faire deben formar equipo para salvar su querido arrecife de la destrucción antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario
programme.desc: Para salvar a su padre de un gran error, Jess, una exdetective de policía, llega a un acuerdo con Mason, un multimillonario que necesita seguridad adicional. Jess trabajará de incógnito como su guardaespaldas. Deberá mantener su tapadera como asistente de Mason mientras afronta los conflictos de personalidad entre ambos y descubre qué amenazas existen realmente.

programme.desc: Una joven y talentosa sous chef en el mejor restaurante de la ciudad de Nueva York recibe una invitación para servir como jueza en un concurso de comida en Kansas, donde se vuelve a conectar con su novio de la universidad.

programme.title: Django (1966)
programme.desc: En un pueblo fantasma, Django arrastra un ataúd misterioso y salva a una mujer. Pronto se ve atrapado entre un mayor racista y un general revolucionario. Las balas vuelan y todos quieren saber qué esconde el ataúd.

programme.title: Vende la pistola y cómprate la tumba
programme.desc: Vende la pistola y cómprate la tumba - Sartana, cazarrecompensas y pistolero, es testigo del robo de un cargamento de oro.

programme.title: No soy un asesino
programme.desc: Un sheriff local es acusado injustamente de asesinato en un pequeño pueblo y obligado a huir.

programme.title: Las águilas negras de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Cuando los comanches se ponen en pie de guerra, los colonos se refugian en la Roca del Águila comandada por el Capitán Jackson.

programme.title: Oeste sin fronteras
programme.desc: Un soldado confederado marginado se redime defendiendo a una mujer de unos bandidos dispuestos a matar por su mina de oro.

programme.title: Bajo el cielo de Arizona
programme.desc: Un vaquero escolta a una niña, cuya madre le heredó una rentable compañía petrolífera, y debe protegerla de un forajido mientras buscan al padre de la niña.

programme.title: La leyenda de la mujer india
programme.desc: Montana, 1874. La Mujer que Camina Lejos, de la tribu Pies Negros, mata a dos hombres que asesinaron a su esposo, lo que la lleva al destierro. Adoptada por los sioux, la tribu de su madre, busca empezar de nuevo mientras enfrenta su pasado y la lucha por la supervivencia en las Grandes Llanuras.

programme.title: En el viejo Oklahoma
programme.desc: En 1906, en las tierras indias de Oklahoma, un vaquero lucha por los derechos de arrendamiento de petróleo contra un codicioso petrolero mientras una bonita maestra de escuela roba el corazón de ambos.

programme.title: Le llamaban Calamidad
programme.desc: Mientras un infame pistolero salva a unos granjeros de gente que intenta explotarlos, se enamora de una hermosa viuda.

programme.title: Bounty Hunter in Trinity
programme.desc: Los habitantes de Trinidad deciden contratar a un famoso cazarrecompensas para protegerse de una feroz banda de forajidos mexicanos que están aterrorizando la zona.

programme.title: Flecha rota
programme.desc: Tom Jeffords intenta hacer la paz entre los colonos y los apaches en el territorio de Arizona.

programme.title: Condenados a vivir
programme.desc: Unos bandidos atacan un vagón cargado de presos y sólo sobreviven un sargento, su hija y siete sádicos prisioneros. El sargento debe llevar a sus prisioneros a su destino mientras se despliega una red de mentiras, codicia y traición.

programme.title: Los cuatro implacables
programme.desc: El Ranger Sam Garrett intenta salvar a un inocente, pero acaba traicionado y perseguido. Sin aliados y con una recompensa por su cabeza, debe enfrentarse solo a cuatro forajidos en una lucha desesperada por limpiar su nombre y sobrevivir.

programme.title: Joaquín Murrieta
programme.desc: La historia de Joaquín Murrieta, un bandido mexicano que aterrorizó California con su banda de asaltantes y asesinos durante la primera mitad del siglo XIX. Algunos lo veían como un forajido asesino, otros como el Robin Hood mexicano.

programme.title: Pagado en sangre
programme.desc: Jeff Cameron es Tom Carter y es un hombre con una misión española: vengarse de su hermano Jerry, que fue asesinado a tiros después de sacar los ahorros de su vida del banco del Cañón del Río.

programme.title: El día de los forajidos
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett es un ranchero que se enfrenta a los granjeros cuando los forajidos asaltan el pequeño pueblo. Los forajidos sólo son controlados por su notorio líder, pero se le diagnostica una herida mortal y el pueblo es un polvorín a punto de estallar.

programme.desc: "Kipper" is an enchanting animated children's series that centers around the whimsical escapades of a lovable dog named Kipper. Alongside his friends, including Tiger the dog, Pig, and Arnold the piglet, Kipper embarks on a variety of adventures that emphasize friendship, curiosity, and the joy of discovery. programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney and the kids explore the wonderful world of counting by playing a variety of fun games, like Barney may I? Barney and the kids help Baby Bop learn how to count to 10 by including her in games, and by taking her on a make-believe shopping trip in the caboose.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney helps Baby Bop and the children discover big and little things in the world around them. When Nick expresses his concern about being the smallest among the kids, Barney steps in to demonstrate how each person's unique size holds its own usefulness. When the group heads out to the park, they begin a creative retelling of Jack and the Beanstalk. Barney and his friends discover everyone is special, regardless of size.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: The children are excited to show Barney all the international flags they are hanging throughout the Caboose, in preparation for the International Fair in the playground later that day. The children learn all about many different countries, including Brazil and Kenya. They learn about the clothing worn by local people, the fascinating animals that live in each land and they also partake in various activities they might join in other countries around the world.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: A make-believe neighborhood in the caboose prompts Barney to teach the kids all about different community helpers. The kids explore all the different roles people have in the community that help them live safely and happily, including doctors, police officers, and teachers. The kids realize its great to celebrate the different ways people help others!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Nick announces to the group that he has a workbook assignment for school to fill out, which involves finding as many squares as he can around the park. Barney decided this is a great opportunity for him and the other kids to join in, and its great fun when Barney and the kids can help a friend!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney and the children have fun playing with toy cars. They take this opportunity to learn about buses and cars, including all the mechanics inside that make them similar. After learning about different kinds of vehicles they may see on the roads, the kids build a bus to take them to their favorite neighborhood spots.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Nick accidentally gets white paint on Sarahs picture, the children must find a way to deal with their emotions. Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry and negative emotions.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: After an abundance of mail arrives at the Caboose for Barney, the kids realize it must be a very special day. Its Barneys birthday! Barneys friends along with Baby Bop and BJ, put together a stupendous party celebration for him in the park, including decorations and cake galore!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney, BJ and the kids spend the day preparing for a very special performance for their friends in the park. They all gather in the caboose to prepare for a stupendous night of singing, dancing, and magical fun.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Sarah and Tony create a beautiful birdhouse to place out in the park. They are happy to learn that the birds will have lots of company; many other animals make their homes in the park too! Barney and the kids travel around the park, noticing and discussing all the various animals that call the park home.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: The children realize its normal to experience all different types of emotions. With Barneys help, the children learn all about how to handle how they are feeling, especially feeling happy, sad, and angry.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: After creating a friends and family tree for a school project, the children discuss all the people in their lives they care about. This provides a perfect opportunity for Barney and his friends to learn about love and relationships.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop's friend Monty the butterfly passes through the park with a flock of friends on their way to Mexico. When Monty gets left behind, Barney takes everyone on a visit to Mexico to return Monty to his insect friends and family and give Baby Bop the chance to say goodbye to her butterfly friend.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney's excited to find out that Rusty's family is adopting a new baby sister from China; however, Rusty's not sure if he's going to be a good brother, and he doesn't know much about China. Barney shows Rusty and the others some info China on the computer and BJ and Baby Bop talk about siblings. Through Barney's Travel Book, Barney takes Rusty, BJ and Baby Bop on an adventure to China where he can learn more about his new sister's heritage. When they get there, the people are celebrating Chinese New Year. From lion dances and talented performers to tasty treats, making lanterns and puppet shows, the celebration never runs out of fun. By the time he returns to the park, Rusty excitedly meets his new baby sister, named Mei Ling, and realizes he will be the best big brother ever.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Ben is late to the park and is disappointed to realize he missed his chance at riding a real pony. He has waited his whole life for this, and now it looks as if hes missed his opportunity. Luckily, Barney takes Ben to Spain where they meet Regalo, a dancing horse with Riff and Baby Bop. Ben and Barney return to the park just in time for him to ride the pony after all! Ben is thrilled to ride a horse and learned an important lesson about patience and waiting.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma is stuck with a school project and can't play soccer with Joshua. Having to interview her parents and get info about an interesting ancestor, she is frustrated with the assignment. Barney helps her discover that her ancestors were from Venice, Italy. Using his Travel Book, Barney takes Joshua, Emma, and Riff to Venice, Italy. He gives his friends a gondola ride as well as telling them about famous explorer Marco Polo. Barney's friend, Anna Maria tells Emma that she knew her great grandfather and takes her to his shop, where they try on masks and make some of their own. Emma learns that if she makes the mask in parts, she'll get it done. Barney reminds her of this lesson, so she will do the same for her school project.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney, Baby Bop, and BJ are helping the kids get ready for a school play. Barney tells everyone that putting on shows began in Greece. Of course, the little dinos and kids want to visit the country, so off they go! While there, they meet some friends and decide to put on a play in an amphitheatre. Barney knows a great story that originated in Greece called King Midas. By the end of the day, everyone has learned that wanting too much is not a good thing, especially BJ!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Ben accidentally includes Kioko's prized music box from Switzerland in a cardboard box of yard sale items-the music box is sold! Kioko is sad and Ben wants to make things right, so he and Barney travel to Switzerland in search of a replacement gift. While there, they sample Swiss food, customs and games-but no music box! Luckily when Ben returns the music box is returned!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When the kids find a mysterious, colorful egg in the park, Barney takes them on a trip to Kenya to try to find out what kind of animal could have laid the egg. While in Kenya, Barney and the kids meet Ayira who introduces them to many people, cultures, and animals of the country!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: A Bird of a Different Feather
programme.desc: Ben and Rusty are looking for items for superhero costumes, when Barney comes to life, wearing a tutu. Tracy comes in and explains that she needs to find a bird of paradise for a school project. Ben, unsure, tells her they're only found in Hawaii and what they look like. Barney then takes the kids to Hawaii, using his Travel Book. In Hawaii, they learn different words, how to make leis and even a hula dance. Meanwhile, Ben and Rusty search for the bird, with a few close calls (a feather and what ended up being a coconut). During the Luau, it's revealed that the Bird of Paradise is actually a flower, not a bird. Ben, believing that it was a bird earlier, is shocked to hear that and apologizes to Rusty for getting him caught up in things. In the end, it all ends up just fine.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma wants to paint an award-winning painting for the Art In The Park Show, but she isn't satisfied with her artwork. Barney takes her to France to learn how to paint from his friend Pierre. While there, they learn about France. And Emma learns how to paint by following her heart!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: It's Earth Day, a great time for everyone to learn how to help take care of our world, but Ben is wasting paper while BJ isn't too concerned about cutting down a tree to make room for a new playground. After a trip to the rainforest and a meeting with Mother Nature, everyone learns the importance of taking care of our world. As Earth Day comes to an end, Barney reminds us all that taking good care of our Earth is the natural thing to dofor the people we love.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney helps Baby Bop see that winter can be a wonderful time for fun. Then, when she least expects itthe snow begins to fall! Barney and his friends are decorating the caboose for Christmas when Barney decides to plan a Secret Santa game. Everyone has to buy or make a gift for the friend whose name they have drawn.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff decides to create a musical zoo when their zoo trip is postponed. Gathering instruments that sound like real animals, Riff gives Barney and his friends a zoo-mazing experience. Baby Bop enjoys her homemade boat but wants to ride in a big one. Barney shows her boats on the computer, while BJ and Riff prepare a surprise. When they return, a sailing ship awaits Baby Bop on the playset!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Melanie is sad because she misses her friend, Marisa who is visiting relatives in India. Barney takes her and the other kids on a trip to the magic caboose to visit pretend countries like Egypt, Tahiti, and India. Barney and the little dinosaurs enjoy an Art Festival. BJ and Riff share some musical art and Baby Bop shares a painting of a very special friendBarney!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When some of the children invite Barney to join them for a race, BJ and Baby Bop decide hell need their help. By the end of the day, everyone finds out that there are many fun ways to exercise. Baby Bop cant wait for BJ and Riff to go on their camping trip so she can have Barney and the park all to herself! But, once theyre gone, she discovers that as more time that goes by, the more she misses them!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney's friends are playing a fun game of I Can Do where they each share something they can do. When BJ suggests having an I Can Do show, Baby Bop becomes worried. Barney shows Baby Bop that while trying something new can sometimes be scary, with help from family and friends, it can also be fun!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Welcome to the neighborhood! Anna has just moved to the neighborhood and is missing her old friends. Barney and his friends help her discover that moving is an adventure with new places to explore and new friends to meet.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Safety first! After learning about fire safety when firefighter Bill visits the caboose, Barney and his friends are inspired to do a little safety inspection of their own. BJ's accident shows why you should only skate outside, and saying be careful is a good way to tell someone how much you love them!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney and his friends have a wheel good fun day learning about cars. Barney creates a colorful, kid-size car, the dinos learn about seatbelt safety, and everyone discovers there are many different styles of cars.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: My Friends, The Doctor and Dentist
programme.desc: Time for a check-up! Barney helps his friends discover the world of doctors and dentists as they learn about healthy habits like brushing teeth, getting checkups, eating healthy foods and getting exercise.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney has a tee-rific surprise for BJ and Baby Bop. Cousin Riff is moving to town! Riff amazes everyone with his awesome musical abilities. When Barney suggests that they put on a show, Riff becomes shy - he's never performed in a show before. With encouragement from Barney, Riff joins in and does what he knows best - making music!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ brings his brand-new toy plane to the park. Riff borrows the plane while BJ is off playing. Unfortunately, curiosity gets the best of Riff and he ends up taking the plane apart to see how it works. Luckily, BJ isnt mad when he finds out. Instead, he shows Riff how to put the plane back together again. Baby Bop is having a great time playing with her homemade boat. However, what she really wants is to ride in a big boat. Barney takes her to look at boats on the computer while BJ and Riff work on a big surprise for her. When Barney and Baby Bop return to the playground, they discover that BJ and Riff have built a sailing ship on the playset for Baby Bop!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop is sad because she lost her pet caterpillar, Monty. Barney and the others try to help her find it. Baby Bop is surprised to discover Monty inside a chrysalis. Everyone is excited to find Monty now a beautiful butterfly! Barney and Baby Bop are thrilled when BJ sets up a bug zoo in the caboose, but Riff isnt so sure he wants to be around bugs. When the park is magically transformed into a amphitheatre with performing insects, Riff discovers that bugs dont bug him after all.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop, BJ and the children prepare for the Shapes Carnival in the park. Riff knows he will do well at the carnival because he is wearing his lucky medal. When he loses the medal, Riff is afraid he wont be able to play the games. With Barneys guidance, Riff has fun playing the games and he realizes he didnt need his lucky medal play and have fun. When it starts to rain at the park, Baby Bop joins Barney and BJ inside the caboose. Baby Bop pokes her head out to see if the rain has stopped and spies a beautiful rainbow in the sky! When the others come to see itits gone. Baby Bop is very disappointed because she liked all the pretty colors, so Barney and the others paint their own life-sized rainbow. When it starts to rain again, the homemade rainbow falls down and gets all wet. Luckily, a real rainbow takes its place!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: An ordinary game of hide and seek takes a not-so-ordinary turn when Baby Bop claims that an elephant is hiding in the park! Barney and Riff are happy to play along, but BJ thinks that his sister may be seeing things. Fortunately, Barney takes this opportunity to help the young dinos learn about their sense of sight while having tons of fun! BJ and Riff engage in a friendly contest to see which of them can find (or make) the loudest sound in the park. The playful competition continues to escalateand along the way, the sounds of animals, musical instruments, and even fire engines are introduced.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff has many special qualities, but sometimes, his shyness makes it hard for him to meet new friends. When Barney introduces Riff to some of his friends in the park, its Baby Bop that ends up feeling less-than-special as the kids seem more impressed with Riff and his special talents. Barney helps Baby Bop realize that theres more to being special than the things you can do. The way you feel and the way you make others feel makes you special, too. Its a special day in the park as Barney and the little dinosaurs enjoy an Art Festival. BJ and Riff share some musical art and Baby Bop shares a painting of a very special friendBarney! As the festival comes to an end, Barney reminds his friends everywhere that no matter what kind of art they make, its always special when it comes from their hearts!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When some of the children in the park invite Barney to join them for a race, BJ and Baby Bop decide hell need their help. They show him several ways to get ready for the big race by warming up and stretching. By the end of the day, everyone finds out that there are many fun ways to exercise. When BJ starts to feel sick after eating too many sweets, he lies down in hopes of feeling better. He has a dream about a snack fantasyland where he eats as many sweets as he wants and ends up with a big stomachache. When he wakes up, hes happy to find out it was only a dream. When he asks for a healthy snack, his friends are happy to oblige.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ and Riff find a pirate map, but in order to find the treasure, they have to be able to count. Since Baby Bop has not learned to count yet, Barney offers to help teach her so she can participate. In the end, Baby Bop learns to count and realizes that feeling good about herself is the greatest treasure in the world! Its time for a music concert in the park. As Riff works on his one-man band, the others make posters for the show. Everyone enjoys Riffs calypso rendition of a favorite song, and they all enjoy helping each other.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ learns that having a pet is a much bigger responsibility than he ever expected when he offers to take care of a friends dog. When he accidentally loses the dog, everyone has to work together to find it. When Baby Bops favorite teddy bear is torn, she wants to take him to the veterinarian for help. Barney and Riff pretend to be veterinarians. They show Baby Bop that theres nothing to be afraid of, because doctors and veterinarians are our friends too.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Baby Bop is surprised by the first day of cold weather, its Barney that helps her see that winter can be a wonderful time for fun. Baby Bop is getting discouraged, wondering if it will ever snow. Then, when she least expects itthe snow begins to fall! On a hot summer day, Barney teaches BJ about all the fun activities you can do during the summer. BJ gets so excited that he corrals Riff into joining him to do a whole summers worth of activities, all in one day! With some help from Baby Bop and the children, Barney teaches BJ that summer means relaxation, too!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Its a very special day at the Parkits Barneys birthday, and there are surprises around every corner. When Barney begins to open his presents, Riff worries that his hand-made gift wont be good enough. In the end, Barney loves Riffs gift and reminds everyone that the best gift of all is one that comes from the heart. Baby Bop is practicing her marching because she will be joining a real marching rhythm band and is having trouble keeping a beat. Barney, BJ and Riff help Baby Bop learn about rhythm just in time for her to join the band.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: A fun day in the park with friends involves a musical rhythm clapping game. Barney introduces a new game that helps reinforce learning about music, rhythm, and musical instruments. This new found inspiration causes the kids to make their very own marching band.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Its a great day to move around in the park! Barney and his friends have fun with creative movement, while learning new dances, having races, and acting out a story. These activities teach the kids how they can move their bodies while doing different activities.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: A mysterious paper airplane flies into the park, inspiring the children to talk about all things Airplanes! The children let their creativity fly when they use their imaginations to build their very own airplane.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: The possibilities are endless as Barney and the kids use their imagination to bring their drawings to life. Barney and the children have an island adventure by imagining themselves in Lauras picture, transporting them to a sunny island!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Celebrate the things that make us special! Barney and his friends discover that trying something new can be fun. Jackson treats everyone to his healthy but unusual snack, while Baby Bop has a special picnic for BJ consisting mostly of her favorite foods.

programme.desc: Oh baby! Oh baby! David has a new baby brother and is now a big brother. But David doesnt know what a big brother is supposed to do and isnt sure hes ready. Barney and his friends help David learn about new babies and how to be a big brother.

programme.desc: Barney and his friends keep on truckin'! BJ enjoys helping with his tow truck, while Barney shows everyone what it's like to be behind the wheel of a real truck. When Jackson's special truck loses a tire, Barney wheels in to the rescue!

programme.title: Cobardes
programme.desc: Gaby, un pelirrojo de 14 ańos en Barcelona, sufre constantes robos y palizas a manos de Guille y su despiadada pandilla, quienes lo apodan "Zanahoria". Incapaz de compartir su sufrimiento con sus padres, siempre ocupados con sus trabajos, Gaby se encierra en sí mismo mientras el bullying se intensifica. La madre de Guille encuentra un video violento en el móvil de su hijo y, aunque lo borra, Guille niega todo y se presenta como víctima ante el psicólogo escolar. - La historia da un giro inesperado cuando el dueńo de la pizzería favorita de Gaby, un mafioso secreto, podría tener una pista que cambiará radicalmente las cosas. La situación se complica aún más cuando los padres de los involucrados, absortos en sus propios problemas, no logran percibir la magnitud del sufrimiento de Gaby, dejándolo cada vez más aislado y vulnerable.

programme.title: Denzura
programme.desc: CHAD es un luchador que busca ser el mejor sin perder sus principios. En la búsqueda de su sueño, conoce a VINCENT, un millonario empresario que intenta manipular las peleas de CHAD para que pierda. CHAD, al no ceder a las conveniencias y planes de VINCENT, comienza a hacerle la vida miserable con el fin de demostrarle las consecuencias de vivir con sus decisiones y que, a veces, aunque intentes corregir tus errores, solo sigues tocando lo más profundo.

programme.title: FinQuest
programme.desc: In Episode 5 of FinQuest, Ryan Miller dives into the vibrant world of offshore fishing off the coast of Palm Beach County. Joined by Cabo Mike, they showcase expert bait techniques and strategies, reeling in a variety of catches, including bonita and a stunning mahi mahi. The duo shares insights into their fishing setup, explains the use of daisy chains, and celebrates their exciting day at sea. With breathtaking views of the ocean and a colorful array of fish, Ryan’s passion for saltwater fishing shines through. The episode wraps up with a reflection on the beauty and bounty of Palm Beach County waters.

programme.title: FinQuest
programme.desc: In Episode 3 of FinQuest, Ryan Miller joins Captain Alex from Supremacy Fishing Charters for an offshore adventure targeting big fish off shore. Starting at the Palm Beach Inlet, the team uses planar fishing techniques to hook wahoo and other catches like kingfish and amberjack. Along the way, firefighter Johnny Bennett shares his journey from fishing to starting a popular fish dip business. The day wraps up with thrilling doubleheader catches and a conservation message, showcasing the importance of sustainable fishing practices.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Is Colorado a Food Utopia? Exploring Farm to Table Cuisine, Epic Landscapes & UFO's"
programme.desc: Everyone knows Colorado for its epic mountains and fresh powder. But on this episode of DIRT, we’re digging into the unexpected side of the state (UFO rumors and all). Whether surfing infinite river waves, cultivating perfect carrot seeds, or fly fishing in downtown Denver’s shadow—geeky passions run high. Follow along as we gather ingredients for a farm to table final feast equal parts foraged, free-range, and free-thinking.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New Zealand’s Wild Flavors, Māori Culture & Volcanic Hot Spring Cooking"
programme.desc: They say you come to New Zealand as a stranger, but leave as family. In this episode of DIRT, the crew goes full circle—meeting Muttonbird chefs Emma and George on the South Island before hopping up to Raglan and working their way back down. Water skiing next to snow-capped mountains, cooking in hot springs the Māori way, and stargazing at Wairarapa Dark Sky Reserve are all on the itinerary. But it’s the final “Feed” done Kiwi-style that makes one thing clear—in this unique and stunning land, nobody’s a stranger for long.

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: "Inside This Adventure Filmmaker's Gear Garage & Colorado Home | Sinuhe Xavier"
programme.desc: This episode of Huckberry Homes brings us out to the Western Slope, just a few miles outside of Vail, Colorado to visit our longtime friend and collaborator Sinuhe Xavier. When he's not traveling the world shooting commercials and making short films, Xavier's at home in his quiet, perfectly appointed retreat deep in the Rockies here he's a three hour drive from Red Rock desert and a ten minute drive from some of the best snowboarding in the world. There was plenty of magic in Sinuhe's spot, from his BMW GS to his exploration of how his love for his son shaped the design and decoration of his pad.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 195
programme.desc: This episode features the luxury and speed of the Celebration for the 40th anniversary of Pershing in Capri, alongside the superyacht prowess of Heesen Yachts' Agnetha, a 55-meter yacht with a 4,500 NM range. programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 196
programme.desc: This segment showcases three impressive boats: the Ranieri International Cayman 50, a 50-foot luxury maxi-RIB capable of 55 knots; the Italian icon Riva 58 Capri, a new sport-open yacht blending high-speed performance and classic elegance; and the Bayliner V36 (PBIBS 2025), a versatile express cruiser known for maximizing family cruising space.

programme.desc: The segment features the Best of Motor Boats at Genoa Boat Show 2025, highlighting top Italian and global innovations. This is contrasted with the high-capacity, versatile Hurricane 3200 Sundeck (MIBS 2025), and the luxurious downeast-style Back Cove 39O (MIBS 2025)

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 191

programme.desc: This episode features the sleek De Antonio D60, a 60-foot Spanish yacht renowned for its clean deck and hidden outboards, alongside a look at the innovative Euthalia lightning protection system. programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: In the 1970's Hollywood began to release a whole new type of musical film. Bob Fosse, Hippies, and Jesus were the new stars in this adventurous period in cinema.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: A TFH collection of some of Hollywoods most memorable "Movies That Rock!"

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. With unprecedented access to previously unseen archive footage, MADE OF STONE is a revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: A TFH collection of some of Hollywoods most memorable "Movies That Rock!"

programme.title: Johnny Thunders - Madrid Memory
programme.desc: A long lost live concert performance from The Heartbreakers explosive 1984 reunion world tour that included fellow Dolls Sylvain Sylvain & Jerry Nolan plus Billy Rath! Filmed for TV broadcast at La Edad De Oro in Madrid, Spain, this concert captures powerful performances of songs from throughout Thunders's amazing career including Personality Crisis, Too Much Junkie Business, Born Too Lose
